title: Spicy Chorizo Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with spicy chorizo and served with a side of velvety sauce.

ingredients.name: Velvety sauce (made with heavy cream and spices)

instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat.
Add sliced chorizo and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Add stir-fry vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together velvety sauce ingredients.
Pour sauce into the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until sauce has thickened.
Serve immediately, garnished with sesame seeds if desired.
